resources.string: Hey there! 👋 We're thrilled to have you on board with our app. The default daily notification time is 6:00 am. You can set up another time that is convenient for you.

To ensure you never miss a moment of inspiration, we'd love to send you daily notifications with our handpicked devotional content.
 Here's why granting notification access is beneficial:
#Receive a daily dose of encouragement, wisdom, and reflection to uplift your day.
 #Get reminders to engage with your daily devotional, making it a seamless part of your routine.
#Tailored notifications based on your preferences, ensuring relevance and resonance.
